piano.appliesTo: All Berceuse pieces when preparing MIDI-based replacement recordings
piano.feedback: The maintainer likes the new YDP variant B very much and selects it as the preferred piano voice for future Berceuse conversions.
piano.soundbank: YDP Grand Piano, FreePats SF2 version 2016-08-04, Yamaha Disklavier Pro
piano.soundbankCredits: Zenph Studios, Dr. Mikhail Krishtal and team; OLPC sound sample library / Dr. Richard Boulanger; SF2 and sample modifications by Roberto (roberto@zenvoid.org), FreePats

renderSettings.tempo: Retain each recording's chosen audition tempo through MIDI-event timing; do not impose the Burgmuller tempo on other pieces or stretch rendered audio
renderSettings.loudnessStrategy: Constant gain only; retain safe peak headroom and note dynamics; no compressor or limiter

piano.verification: Confirm actual reverb in the output using a wet/dry comparison. Earlier Salamander A/B renders were effectively identical because no MIDI reverb send reached the effect. Check loudness matching, full decoding, headroom, quiet ending and retained credits before delivering an audition.

strings.envelope: Squared-sine attack, squared-cosine release; durations from per-note arrangement metadata. For original tempo multiply sleep-event times and envelope durations by 0.833333.
strings.room: Deterministic RNG seed 1097; mono per-note IR, length 0.35s, T60 0.24s, 9ms predelay, second-order 4500Hz lowpass, energy-normalized; wet gain 0.18, before per-note release gate.
strings.samplePreparation: Decode 44100 Hz stereo; remove leading recording silence up to first 10ms RMS block >=1.5% of maximum block RMS, retain 35ms lead. Fold stereo to mono and normalize RMS over 0.5-2.5s to 0.08. Resample mapped pitch using source SFZ root/tune and polyphase conversion (rational denominator <=2048). No sample loops required.
strings.filters: Second-order highpass: cello 80Hz, viola 110Hz, violin 150Hz; second-order 6200Hz lowpass. Equal-power pan. Per-note velocity multiplier (velocity/48)^1.25; sustained bow swell 0.94+0.06*sin(0..pi).
strings.note: MIDI file notes already have the 0.8 render-velocity scale. Do not soften them a second time. General MIDI string voices and envelopes do not reproduce the sample-rendered MP3 exactly.

synthesizer: FluidSynth 2.6.1; render piano with gain 0.6, no chorus, reverb and explicit CC91=90; pad eight seconds for room decay before tail trim
encoders: LAME via lameenc, 256 kbps stereo, quality 2
